summary: VolitionRx Ltd filed an 8-K reporting entry into a waiver and consent agreement with Lind Global Asset Management XII LLC regarding a failure to comply with a minimum market capitalization covenant under existing senior secured convertible promissory notes. The waiver prevents Lind from accelerating obligations or foreclosing on collateral due to the covenant breach but imposes a 10% additional amount on the outstanding principal. No new special-situation transaction—such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—is announced; the filing addresses a routine covenant waiver under existing debt. Therefore, this is not a special situation.
